categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: steel pipes and copper alloys. The steel pipe segment produces structural steel pipes, gas pipes, oil pipelines, steel pipe piles, and coated steel pipes for water supply and general use. The copper alloy segment, through its subsidiary KBI Alloy Co., Ltd., manufactures and sells alloyed copper products used mainly in electrical wiring and power generation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including JCO and BP line processes for steel pipe production, with facilities capable of producing thick-walled pipes and coated pipes. It also employs high-frequency electric melting, extrusion, and drawing processes for copper alloy production. The company holds multiple patents related to welding robots, coating methods, and pipe manufacturing equipment, emphasizing innovation in production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include public institutions such as procurement agencies and construction companies for domestic sales, and local and direct export customers in regions like the Middle East, Africa, South America, Southeast Asia, the US, and Europe. The steel pipe products serve infrastructure projects including water supply, gas, and oil transportation, while copper alloys are mainly used in electrical and automotive industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with headquarters in Cheonan and production facilities in Cheongju and Asan. It has a sales office in Seoul and exports products primarily to the Middle East, Africa, South America, Southeast Asia, the US, and Europe, with ongoing efforts to expand its international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing steel pipes and copper alloy products from raw materials such as plates, coils, and electric copper. It procures raw materials from major steel producers and government procurement agencies and sells finished products to construction firms, public institutions, and export markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality and sophistication, transitioning sales from domestic to export markets, and securing liquidity through improved sales methods. The company invests in R&D through its research institute focusing on new technologies and product improvements, supported by government grants. It also pursues facility upgrades and new equipment investments to meet market demand and maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of steel pipes and copper alloys. The company also earns income from by-products, merchandise sales, and real estate leasing. Domestic sales include both cash and credit terms, while exports are conducted on a cash basis. The company secures contracts through bidding and direct negotiations with customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic large steel pipe market, competitors include Hyundai Steel, SeAH Steel, and Korea Cast Iron Pipe. The company has maintained a stable market position since the 1970s based on product quality. In the copper alloy sector, competition is limited with few domestic players, and the company holds a significant position in export markets, especially in the US and Europe.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 278.3 billion KRW, showing a 4.56% increase from the previous year. Operating profit declined by 71.6% to about 2.2 billion KRW, and net income turned negative at -1.56 billion KRW due to rising raw material costs and geopolitical risks. Total assets stood at approximately 208.8 billion KRW with a debt ratio increasing to 139.7%. The company is classified as a mid-sized enterprise.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced steel pipes and copper alloys recognized for superior performance in domestic and international markets. It differentiates through patented manufacturing processes, product innovation, and a focus on meeting stringent infrastructure and electrical industry standards. The company also leverages its long-standing market presence and continuous R&D to maintain competitive advantage.
